name.description: The name of the plant; levels and rules use it

frame.description: The picture of the content atlas this uses (a frame name)

size.description: small, tall or tree: it decides the default height of its shadow

blocks.description: true: it blocks walking like a rock

edible.description: true: it heals the hero when destroyed

inspect.description: The text shown when the player looks at it

tags.description: Tags it carries; writing tags replaces the ones its fields give (plant, edible, solid, tree)

height.description: Height in metres; the length of its shadow depends on it (0: no shadow)

shadow.description: false: casts no shadow whatever its height
